verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows the reverse relationship: Vast.ai exposes a CLI/API/agent-skill so that external AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Copilot) can drive Vast.ai on the user's behalf — not that Vast.ai itself ships a built-in AI assistant a user can delegate tasks to within the product. No docs, UI, or probes mention any native chatbot/copilot embedded in the Vast.ai console.
